details.effect: [evolve] Banish 2 cards in your cemetery: Evolve this follower.

issues: The evolve ability is encoded incorrectly as burying field followers; it should banish 2 cards from your cemetery as the evolve cost, e.g. an `evolve` ability with cost `{ "banishFromCemetery": { "filter": { "cardClass": "abyss" }, "count": 2 } }` or equivalent cemetery-banish encoding, not `buryFieldFollowers`.

details.effect: [fanfare] [costX]: Summon X Steelclad Knight tokens. X equals a number of your choice. [act] [engage]: For the rest of this turn, each [swordcraft] follower currently on your field has Rush and Assail.

issues: The fanfare ability is missing the [costX] payment linkage; choosing X and summoning X tokens should be tied to paying X PP, not just a free chosen-number effect. Encode the fanfare with an X-cost payment and then summon X Steelclad Knight tokens.

The activated ability is encoded incorrectly; it should give each Swordcraft follower currently on your field Rush and Assail for the rest of this turn, not grant a trigger for future card plays. Replace `grantOnCardPlayed` with an immediate field-wide grant/buff effect applying Rush and Assail to your current Swordcraft followers until end of turn.

details.cardSet: Booster Set #9 "Duet of Dawn and Dusk"
details.effect: [q][act] [engage], bury this card: Select an enemy follower on the field and deal it 3 damage.

issues: The activated ability is missing `quick: true` on the ability itself. The source is `[q][act]`, so the activated ability should be marked as quick, not only by putting `quick` in `keywords`.

details.cardSet: Combined Set "Banquet of Dreams & Trial of the Omens"
details.effect: [evolve] [cost01]: Evolve this. [fanfare] Select up to 2 enemy followers on the field and engage them.

issues: The fanfare ability is encoded incorrectly as banishing up to 2 enemy followers; it should engage up to 2 enemy followers. Replace `banishUpTo` with an `engage` effect targeting up to 2 enemy followers.
